subject.title: fix(message): ignore populated location on text sends

question: Should OpenClaw adopt `normalizeMessageActionRequest` as the permanent Plugin SDK lifecycle hook for channel-owned action rewriting before shared dispatch?
rationale: This is an additive public Plugin SDK/action contract rather than a Telegram-only repair; code review can assess the implementation, but only maintainers can choose whether this extension point is the desired long-term API boundary.

options.title: Adopt the normalization hook
options.body: Approve the additive SDK contract, retain the producer-side Telegram repair, and require final-head live Telegram evidence before merge.

options.title: Narrow the design
options.body: Request a Telegram-local or existing-seam solution if maintainers do not want a general pre-dispatch normalization API.

recommendation.title: Adopt the normalization hook
recommendation.body: Approve the additive SDK contract, retain the producer-side Telegram repair, and require final-head live Telegram evidence before merge.
